items.headline: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
items.summary: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

items.headline: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
items.summary: Gondola helps creatives get credit and get hired, with Codex raising its lead engineer’s output by 50% and ChatGPT simplifying daily work.

items.headline: Gemini Decisions API
items.summary: Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question.

items.headline: aws-emulator
items.summary: Finally, an official emulator from AWS to run tests against a local clone of their many different services without having to provision a paid API key to do so. It's written in Rust by a huge swarm of agents - 29,684 commits in the first three weeks of the project.

items.headline: Let’s talk about Jensen Huang’s many affairs!
items.summary: Usually, we'd be offering to answer your questions about a news event, but honestly we don't really have any answers about what the hell is going on over at Nvidia. I can't speak for Nilay but at the rate Jensen Huang's new mistresses are dropping, I am concerned we are...

items.headline: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trum
items.summary: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.
